title: ERN Source Partner Strategy
productPrinciple: See Live → trust the source → discover the place → optionally plan or buy.
sourceButtonInvariant: Open Live Source must remain the genuine provider handoff. It is not a disguised ad, affiliate redirect or paid-ranking mechanism.
possibleValueModels: clearly labeled sponsored business utility separate from Earth ranking
fixed source-partner or destination-partner fee only when editorial neutrality is preserved
visitorBenefitExamples: useful source-owner offer connected to the exact place
evidenceRules: Use aggregate external_source_opened counters by source ID.
Do not infer bookings, sales, source playback, or provider endorsement from outbound clicks.
Do not invent traffic thresholds; use repeated meaningful evidence plus source-owner fit.
Government/science/public-interest sources can remain traffic-only indefinitely.
commercialNeutrality: Commission cannot affect Watch Earth ranking.
Paid sources cannot displace a more useful or more truthful Earth source.
Every commercial relationship must be disclosed where a visitor could reasonably interpret it as commercial.

currentEvidence.caveat: Aggregate directional evidence only; the current traffic base is still small and this is a learning/qualification stage.

initialObservedCandidates.reason: Commercial hospitality source with direct destination relevance; useful future stay/visitor-benefit partnership candidate.
Resort source can naturally support lift/activity/stay utility if a future partner path is agreed.
Direct place/source fit; future lift, stay, lesson or visitor-benefit partnership is plausible after traffic matures.
Direct destination operator relationship could support tickets/transport/visitor benefits without changing Earth ranking.
Direct resort-operated live source; potential future stay/referral/visitor-benefit relationship.
Hotel-operated source with natural stay/referral fit.
Hotel-operated live source with natural stay/referral or visitor-benefit fit.

notOutreachReadyReason: Current counts are useful qualification evidence but still too small to justify broad partner outreach. Continue measuring, improve qualified traffic, and promote only when repeated source-specific value becomes meaningful.
next: Add provider/source-owner classification to future private business reports.
Promote candidates to outreach-ready only after repeated aggregate demand plus verified source ownership and a clear visitor benefit.
When outreach begins, lead with measured ERN traffic and visitor value, not paid ranking.
Prefer a visitor benefit + referral/commission structure where appropriate.
